**Finding submitted: deviation (GOVLAW).**

- **Responsive locations:** §14(a) (p0064) governing law/venue, §8 "Arbitration" (p0028), and §14(d) (p0067) prevailing-party costs. No other governing-law or forum language exists in the document.
- **Problem:** §14(a) selects Delaware law but exclusive New York, New York courts (no "corresponding" Delaware forum, so the fallback is not literally met), and §8 mandates AAA arbitration for "any controversy or claim", which displaces the court forum altogether and contradicts §14(a).
- **Cure (preferred level, 4 surgical replaces):** Delaware → New York law; venue clarified to New York County; §8 arbitration mandate replaced with an exclusive reference to the §14(a) courts, with the heading conformed so no dangling "Arbitration" label remains. Jury waiver, one-year limitation and conflict-of-laws wording preserved verbatim; the fallback (Delaware/California law with matching courts) is offered in the comment.
